purpose: Complete source-corpus counterpart inventory, with one explicit scenario-local framework exclusion. Fixture coverage does not claim passing implementation or complete Rust unit-test parity.

registration-uncertain-dynamic.reason: Dynamic matcher provenance never grants trusted registration status.

registration-uncertain-nested.reason: Nested registration execution is uncertain and must remain incomplete.

registration-shadowing.reason: A method redefinition removes registration trust conservatively.

matcher-family.reason: Includes exact duplicate and near-wording positive controls plus regex, exact-text, and polarity distinctions.

assertion-and-polarity.reason: Identical source reuse is distinct from assertion trust. An undeclared expect method must not create assertion-based similarity; opposite effects must remain distinct.

usage-indirect.reason: Literal step invocation marks its target used; unrelated definition remains unused.

load-relative.reason: Literal require_relative visits source once; feature evidence must preserve ambiguity.

load-unresolved.reason: Dynamic/external loads remain incomplete while preserving independent local definitions.

load-cycle.reason: Cycle terminates and contributes each step source once.

load-provider-root.reason: Configured rubyLoadPaths root resolves one provider without executing it.

polarity.reason: Preserve the original polarity-negative configuration and add a meaningful member-call positive. Disabling similarity cannot satisfy both.

load-helper-dispatch-contained.reason: A dynamic dispatch inside an instance method of a helper class, in a suite whose load-time code is only registrations, literal loads and plain class definitions, cannot run during load: registrations survive. The run stays incomplete because the dispatch may call `step` while a scenario runs (indirect usage unknown).
